messages:
Leah (Finance): Heads up — CloudCraft submitted their March invoice PDFs and one is missing the reserved capacity and VAT line items; the other is duplicated with a full total. Can we triage?
billing-bot: Alert: invoice_generation_anomaly=2 customer_id=cloudcraft run=batch_2026_03_20 severity=high
Ivy (Support): Ticket #5688: https://support.redwood.ai/t/5688 — customer attached both PDFs and says their AP team is holding payment until corrected.
Noah (Billing Eng): Querying invoices: invoice_ids 2026-03-20011 (total_cents=0, line_items=2) and 2026-03-20011-a (total_cents=1925000, line_items=8) from same batch. Both reference batch_2026_03_20_0300.
Carlos (Payments): Captured on the -a invoice only. No refunds yet.
Leah (Finance): Priority: void the zero invoice, regenerate canonical PDF with audit note, and issue credit memo if any overcharge. Customer needs corrected docs by EOD PST.
Noah (Billing Eng): Plan: 1) mark 2026-03-20011 status=void (preserve record) 2) regenerate PDF for 2026-03-20011-a with note "voided duplicate attached" 3) run ledger backfill check. Will run void now.
billing-bot: Task update: void_invoice job started invoice=2026-03-20011 actor=noah
billing-bot: Task update: void_invoice job completed invoice=2026-03-20011 status=success ts=1862000201
Noah (Billing Eng): Regenerated PDF and uploaded to ticket. Added audit line: "Duplicate incomplete invoice voided (batch batch_2026_03_20_0300). Canonical invoice retained."
Ivy (Support): Sent updated PDF to CloudCraft. They replied: "Thanks. Please confirm VAT/tax lines and that their accounting will see the credit memo on next statement."
Leah (Finance): VAT present on canonical invoice. I'll create credit memo CM-2026-03-0782 and link to account; Carlos please process any refund if needed.
Carlos (Payments): Will stand by; no refund required now. If finance requests refund I can process immediately.
Noah (Billing Eng): Root cause: race between invoice_writer and post-process promo/tax patch that ran concurrently for this customer. I'll open PR to add a batch_run lock and make post-process idempotent. ETA for PR review and deploy: 24 hours.
Leah (Finance): Thanks. Please drop a short RCA here once PR merged so we can share with customer. Closing loop when credit memo posted. :white_check_mark:
